frame.name: target_centered_circular_chief_LVLH
frame.orbit_normal_policy: planar_only; reject nonplanar inputs rather than silently project

time.property_scope: all of [0,T], including initial and final positions, in every mode
time.hold_scope: a continuous 60 s interval inside hold position and speed bounds; later holding does not erase earlier violations
time.new_adjudication: independent continuous-interval safe/violated/unresolved judgments required; point samples cannot certify an interval; numerical accuracy deferred to Task 03

phases.approach: S=A union H remains required; no global approach speed limit is added
phases.holding: S remains required; H and speed apply to hold qualification
phases.abort: abort requests do not relax S or erase flags; continue all components to T; record task completion false
phases.abort_corridor: not specified; any future authorized departure needs a different prospective contract and separate endpoint

control.coordinate_hold: zero-order hold in LVLH components; inertial direction rotates with the chief
control.realized_acceleration: eta * held_command + bounded additive disturbance; delay applies before command replacement
control.fallback: historical same-LQR substitution and zero-thrust paths are descriptive only; neither is an invariant backup certificate
control.new_recovery_policy: not implemented or certified in Task 02

information.age: decision minus measurement time; distinct from applied minus decision delay
information.old_commands: known command history must be propagated; do not blindly add age and delay to a current posterior error bound
information.disturbance_assumption: every episode explicitly declares a finite disturbance bound and effectiveness interval; Gaussian draws are not globally bounded by standard deviation
information.online_access: timestamped observations, permitted history, commands, certified bounds; no latent state except declared ideal-information fixtures

initial_classification.position: inside or outside S, independent of velocity feasibility
initial_classification.historical_membership: retain all 534 initially outside E004 primary roots; do not redefine or exclude them

requirement_authority.geometric_numbers: benchmark research choices from E004/E005; not an operational flight corridor or a standard
requirement_authority.engineering_context: NASA/TM-2011-217088, Orbital Express abort and safe-hold account; supports mission-specific abort design, not these dimensions
